paragraphs: I'm a Frontend Developer focused on building responsive, intuitive, and performant web applications. I enjoy turning ideas and designs into well-structured interfaces, with an emphasis on usability, clean code, and thoughtful UI architecture.

My primary expertise is in React, Next.js, and TypeScript. I've also built full-stack projects using Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB, handling the complete development process—from planning features and designing system architecture to developing APIs, managing data, and integrating the frontend and backend.

I've deployed multiple projects to Vercel through GitHub-based CI/CD workflows and worked on UI testing. I've also developed Digital Dost, a React Native mobile learning application, which is being prepared for its Google Play Store release.
I approach development by understanding how a product should work as a whole. I value problem-solving, maintainable architecture, performance, and building reliable solutions that are easy to extend.
